headline: Johannesburg Stock Exchange Rises 1.1% Led by Resource Shares
summary: South Africa's JSE Index advanced 1.1% supported by resource stock strength, even as the rand weakened against the U.S. dollar.
why: The JSE is Africa's largest stock exchange, where heavy weightings in global mining stocks make it sensitive to global commodity prices.

impacts.name: South African Mining Sector
impacts.why: Gains in underlying commodity prices boosted resource company share valuations on the JSE.

why_moved: Strong gains across mining and resource stocks drove the JSE 1.1% higher despite broad currency weakness in the South African rand.
